tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rgyal chen sde bzhi'i mchod thabs bzhugs so// 1$0000300hūm̐: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: dkar ser dmar ljang hūm̐ chen bzhi: 'phro 'dus 'od du zhu ba las: ye shes rgyal po bzhi ru gyur: oṃ dzñā na rā dza sa ma ye swā hā: hūm̐: ri rgyal lhun po'i shar phyogs su: pho brang chen po spos ngad ldan: zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung: sku mdog dkar po pi waṃ bsnams: btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas: 'khor ni dri za 'bum gyis bskor: sde bo che la stobs po che: mchod gtor 'di bzhes shar phyogs kyi: gdon rnams bzlog cing phyi mtshams srungs: hūm̐: ri rgyal lhun po'i lho phyogs su: pho brang chen po bai ḍūr+ya: zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: sku mdog ser po ral gri 'dzin: btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas: 'khor ni grul bum 'bum gyis bskor: sde bo che la stobs po che: mchod gtor 'di bzhes lho phyogs kyi: gdon rnams bzlog cing phyi mtshams srungs: hūm̐: ri rgyal lhun po'i nub phyogs su: pho brang chen po rgya mtsho'i dpal: zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang: sku mdog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin: btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas: 'khor ni klu dbang 'bum gyis bskor: sde bo che la stobs po che: mchod gtor 'di bzhes nub phyogs kyi: gdon rnams bzlog cing phyi mtshams srungs: hūm̐: ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs su: pho brang chen po lcang lo can: zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: sku mdog ljang gu rgyal mtshan 'dzin: btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas: 'khor ni gnod sbyin 'bum gyis bskor: sde bo che la stobs po che: mchod gtor 'di bzhes byang phyogs kyi: gdon rnams bzlog cing phyi mtshams srungs: hūm̐:

rgyal po chen po sde bzhi po: don la sangs rgyas yin mod kyang: gsang sngags bstan pa srung ba'i phyir: bar chad 'dul bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ dhṛṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā: oṃ bai rū ḍha kā ya swā hā: oṃ bi rū pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: i daṃ ba lin+ta khā hi: 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di phul bas: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du: rkyen phyi yi bar chad nang du mi gtong zhing: nang gi dngos grub phyir mi 'chor ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol:
